track.title: Shur: Zirkesh-E Salmak I and II

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on D in Zirkesh-E Salmak I and II. The line peaks at E4 (315.6 Hz) at 0:14.5. It closes on A3, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → D4 → E3 → E4 → A3).
